text: 据新华社报道，近日，记者深入多地一线调研发现，“稳楼市”政策持续显效，市场信心和预期逐步改善，刚性和改善性住房需求有序释放，房地产市场继续保持稳的态势。 “去库存”是打通市场堵点、释放有效供给的重要举措。从土地端看，2026年上半年，“控量提质”成为全国土地市场的主基调。在“控增量”“去库存”的同时，“优供给”引导住宅新增供给向高品质升级，进一步提升激活需求。
text_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, recent in-depth surveys across multiple regions found that the 'stabilizing the housing market' policy continues to show effectiveness, with market confidence and expectations gradually improving, rigid and improvement-oriented housing demand being released in an orderly manner, and the real estate market maintaining a stable trend. 'Reducing inventory' is a key measure to unblock market bottlenecks and release effective supply. From the land perspective, 'controlling quantity and improving quality' became the main theme of the national land market in the first half of 2026. Alongside 'controlling new supply' and 'reducing inventory,' 'optimizing supply' guides new housing supply towards higher quality upgrades, further boosting demand activation.
